messages:
maria: heads up — coordinated deploy planned tonight 22:00 PST. components: api@v2.4.1, runtime@v1.8.0-quant, router@v2.9.0, console@v3.2.0. change window 22:00-23:30. rollback triggers: error rate >1.5% sustained 5m, or p99 latency >800ms for 2 consecutive 5m. release notes: https://go/release/2401023456 :rocket:

sam: ack. i'll own rollout ops and rollback. pins to apply: api -> api-pin=v2.4.1, runtime -> runtime-pin=1.8.0-q, router -> router-pin=2.9.0, console -> console-pin=3.2.0. commands ready in #runbooks. :white_check_mark:

kai: quick q — canary split? order? also what’s the tiebreaker if router hits latency but api ok?

jen: we validated staging earlier. suggested order: runtime (kernel+quant) -> router (routing rules + sticky sessions) -> api (feature flags) -> console (ui/metrics). router latency should be evaluated together with runtime p99; if router latency spikes but runtime p99 stable, pause router canary and roll back router only. if runtime p99 spikes, rollback runtime then router.

maria: good. for canaries: start at 5% for 15m, then 25% for 10m, then ramp to 100% if metrics stable. monitor agent links below. also note KV cache warmup may increase early p95 on runtime.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy event created by @maria for 2026-07-18T22:00:00-07:00. canary steps: [5%, 25%, 100%]. monitoring dashboards: https://dash/release/2401023456. alert channels: #oncall, #eng-sre.

sam: rollback commands (keeps simple):
```
# pin back to previous
./deployctl pin runtime runtime-pin=1.7.9
./deployctl pin router router-pin=2.8.7
# force traffic back
./routerctl set-split service=api split=100:0
```
I'll paste full runbook into #runbooks in 10m.

kai: noted re: sticky sessions. one more: console migration depends on console schema flag flip which is reversible, but we should gate it until api routes at 25% are stable.

jen: ops note — watch these exact metrics: runtime/p99, router/latency_p99, api/error_rate, console/frontend-err-rate. thresholds: runtime p99>700ms warn, >800ms rollback; router p99>750ms warn, >900ms rollback. i'm oncall for first 45m.

maria: assigning observers: jen (first 45m), sam (fallback), kai (routing checks). @deploy-bot will post canary milestones automatically. if any rollback action taken, call it out here and update runbook with exact timestamps. :memo:

sam: i'll start the preflight at 21:30 PST — health checks, certs, and feature-flag gating. ping me in-thread if you see anything odd.

maria: thanks team — greenlight on my side. syncing in 30m for live countdown. :shipit:
